BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to defining allowable fuel blends; amending RCW19.112.100; and adding a new section to chapter 19.112 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.112 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No wholesale motor fuel dealer or motor fuel retailer may sellor offer to sell any gasoline blended or mixed with any of thefollowing: (a) Ethanol, unless the blend or mixture meets the specificationsor registration requirements established by the federal environmentalprotection agency pursuant to section 211 of the clean air act, 42U.S.C. Sec. 7545 and 40 C.F.R. Part 79; (b) Methyl tertiary butyl ether in concentrations that exceedfifteen onehundredths of one percent by volume; or (c) A total of all of the following oxygenates that exceeds onetenth of one percent by weight, of: (i) Diisopropylether; (ii) Ethyl tert-butylether; (iii) Iso-butanol; p. 1 HB 2007 (iv) Iso-propanol; (v) N-butanol; (vi) N-propanol; (vii) Sec-butanol; (viii) Tert-amyl methyl ether; (ix) Tert-butanol; (x) Tert-pentanol or tert-amyl alcohol; and (xi) Any other additive that has not been approved by theCalifornia air resources board or the federal environmental protectionagency as of the effective date of this section, or such subsequentdate as may be provided by the board or agency by rule, consistent withthe purposes of this section. (2) Nothing in this section prohibits transshipment through thisstate, or storage incident to the transshipment, of gasoline thatcontains methyl tertiary butyl ether in concentrations that exceedfive-tenths of one percent by volume or any of the oxygenates listed insubsection (1)(c) of this section, provided: (a) The gasoline is used or disposed of outside this state; and (b) The gasoline is segregated from gasoline intended for usewithin this state.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.112.100 and 2001 c 218 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Methyl tertiarybutyl ether may not be intentionally added to anygasoline, motor fuel, or clean fuel produced for sale or use in thestate of Washington after December 31, 2003((, and)). In no event maymethyl tertiarybutyl ether be knowingly mixed in gasoline above ((sixtenths)) fifteen one-hundredths of one percent by volume.
